ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
IF @TipPlata = 'ALIMENTARE_SALARII'
BEGIN

INSERT INTO app.SumaBRD
(
    Marca,
    Nume,
    CNP,
    Cont,
    Suma,

    Luna,
    Anul,

    DataPlatii,
    DenumireFisier,

    Recreat,

    Valid,
    MesajValidare,

    CodSucursala,

    CreatedDate
)

SELECT

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Date salariat
    -------------------------------------------------
    cl.Marca,

    s.Nume,

    s.CNP,

    cb.ContIBAN,

    cl.NetdePlata,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Perioada payroll
    -------------------------------------------------
    cl.Luna,

    cl.Anul,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Data platii
    -------------------------------------------------
    @DataPlatii,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Denumire fisier
    -------------------------------------------------
    @CodSucursala
    + FORMAT(CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE),'ddMMyy')
    + '.brd',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Recreat
    -------------------------------------------------
    'NU',

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Valid
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE

        WHEN cb.ContIBAN IS NULL
             OR LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.ContIBAN)) = ''
        THEN 'NU'

        WHEN ISNULL(cb.Valid,0) = 0
        THEN 'NU'

        ELSE 'DA'

    END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Mesaj validare
    -------------------------------------------------
    CASE

        WHEN cb.ContIBAN IS NULL
             OR LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.ContIBAN)) = ''
        THEN 'IBAN lipsa'

        WHEN ISNULL(cb.Valid,0) = 0
        THEN 'IBAN invalid'

        ELSE 'OK'

    END,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Cod sucursala
    -------------------------------------------------
    cl.CodSucursala,

    -------------------------------------------------
    -- Audit
    -------------------------------------------------
    SYSDATETIMEOFFSET()

FROM app.CalculLichidare cl

INNER JOIN app.CardBRD cb
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(cb.Marca))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Marca))

INNER JOIN app.Salariat s
    ON LTRIM(RTRIM(s.Marca))
     = LTRIM(RTRIM(cl.Marca))

WHERE cl.Luna = @Luna
  AND cl.Anul = @Anul
  AND cl.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

  -------------------------------------------------
  -- Doar sume pozitive
  -------------------------------------------------
  AND ISNULL(cl.NetdePlata,0) > 0

  END
